title: CmdPal: Honor the PowerToys language setting

status.label: Product direction and findings pending
status.detail: The outstanding review was consumed and two review rounds advanced the fork to zero unresolved Copilot threads. Two additional culture-correctness concerns remain after cutoff, and a maintainer decision is still needed on whether Command Palette should follow PowerToys settings or Windows display language.

next_action: Obtain the CmdPal language-boundary decision. If the change should proceed, fix invalid override publication and formatting-culture mutation on fork head 1d27514f, rebuild, and request one fresh Copilot review.

phase0.detail: A collaborator stated that Command Palette is intentionally disconnected from PowerToys settings; the author asked whether Windows display language should remain authoritative and offered to close the PR.

fork_head.details: All targeted affected projects built after clearing inherited GIT_CONFIG_* variables. A full module-chain build was not rerun before the bounded cutoff.

upstream_safety.detail: No public mutation was made to microsoft/PowerToys.
